discussionsTitle: One work. One chapter. Your perspectives.
discussionsHint: Find conversations about your recent readings. Use a number to focus on a chapter or episode, without claiming to track every release.
xpRules: {{xp}}/30 contribution XP this week. No XP for likes or replies.
rules: A first eligible review per work and chapter/episode can earn 10 XP, capped at 30 XP per week and 50,000 lifetime community XP. You must have recorded the corresponding progress. Editing or republishing the same review does not earn more points. Whole-work reviews have their own one-time award. Temporary titles expire on the Monday after the next week; badges remain yours.
usefulRules: For helpfulness awards, only first reactions from distinct readers with accounts at least 7 days old and outside your friends count, on reviews published this week. These safeguards limit vote trading without guaranteeing the absence of fraud.
readingRules: Reading is self-reported. Imports and new works establish a baseline: they do not count as weekly reading. Lowering and raising progress does not count twice. An update adds at most 50 chapters to the counter; shōnen depends on verified catalog demographic metadata, not a claimed genre.
noDistinctions: Publish your first review after recording your reading to unlock an award.
boardHint: Weekly leaderboards of public profiles, independent of overall level. Tied scores share their rank.
noLeaders: The first contributions of the week will appear here.
houseRulesTitle: Disagreement belongs here. Unmarked spoilers don’t.
houseRules: Discuss the work, respect the person. Hide revelations and save later chapters for their own discussion.
notifyReplies: Notify me in the app when someone replies to my review
notifyDigest: Receive the weekly gathering in my notifications
notificationPrivacy: Notifications contain no review or reply excerpts. No push notifications are enabled here.
